Time Inconsistency and the Tradeoff Between Inflation and Unemployment
APPENDIX
8The material in this appendix is derived from Finn E. Kydland and Edward C. Prescott, “Rules Rather Than Discretion: The Inconsistency of Optimal Plans,” Journal of Political Economy 85 (June 1977): 473–492; and Robert J. Barro and David Gordon, “A Positive Theory of Monetary Policy in a Natural Rate Model,” Journal of Political Economy 91 (August 1983): 589–610. Kydland and Prescott won the Nobel Prize for this and other work in 2004.
